name: Aussie Dollar Token
oneLiner: AUDX is TAU Pty Ltd's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, designed for 1:1 AUD redemption and backed by AUD cash and government-backed instruments.
collateral: Backed 1:1 by Australian-dollar cash and government-backed instruments such as Treasury Bills and Notes, held by TAU Pty Ltd trading as AUDX Token
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption path targeting 1 AUDX = 1 AUD through fully backed Australian-dollar reserves

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: TAU Pty Ltd's terms state that each AUDX is pegged and redeemable 1:1 to AUD and that the company holds one AUD for every token minted. Aura Partners' May 2026 limited-assurance report separately reconciles designated AUD reserve accounts with reported AUDX supply, supporting the issuer-managed fiat-cash archetype.

sources.label: Aura Partners AUDX Limited Assurance Report - May 2026

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The reviewed AUDX ERC1967 deployment evidence identifies a BLACKLISTER role alongside DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER, MINTER_ROLE, SALVAGER, and UPGRADER on the Ethereum and Polygon token contracts. That role is issuer-controlled through the deployment admin, so AUDX has direct holder-level transfer restriction capability; the issuer also describes AUDX as an issuer-managed token available on Ethereum and Polygon.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: TAU Pty Ltd issuer-native multichain AUDX: terms state issuance on Ethereum and Polygon and expressly permit issuance on other blockchains; the issuer website claims 12+ supported chains. Exact on-chain checks at Conflux eSpace block 153047580 and XDC block 105432932 re-confirm Aussie Dollar Token / AUDX / 18 decimals with MINTER_ROLE held by the same issuer EOAs already inventoried in mintAuthority (0x1274d873 on Conflux; 0xc9d8603b on XDC, matching Ethereum/Polygon). All four tracked deployments are reviewed as native-issuance issuer routes with no third-party bridge controller.

routes.reviewNote: TAU's current terms state that AUDX is issued on Ethereum and Polygon and that the company may mint or transfer AUDX to a nominated wallet. At Ethereum block 25573503, this exact address returned Aussie Dollar Token, AUDX, and 18 decimals, and MINTER_ROLE was true for the deployment minter 0xc9d8603bcf23d148a56980e6a7e3e0d375ea3e28. No third-party bridge is documented for the issued Ethereum token.

TAU's current terms state that AUDX is issued on Ethereum and Polygon and that the company may mint or transfer AUDX to a nominated wallet. At Polygon block 90560276, this exact address returned Aussie Dollar Token, AUDX, and 18 decimals, and MINTER_ROLE was true for the deployment minter 0xc9d8603bcf23d148a56980e6a7e3e0d375ea3e28. No third-party bridge is documented for the issued Polygon token.

Write-time re-read at Conflux eSpace block 153047580: name()=Aussie Dollar Token, symbol()=AUDX, decimals=18, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x1274d87337eb9091e22b9686ae34ad54c989c883)=true. That minter is the same Conflux DEFAULT_ADMIN+MINTER EOA already inventoried in mintAuthority. TAU terms §2 authorize issuance on blockchains beyond Ethereum/Polygon; the issuer website states 12+ supported chains. No third-party bridge controller is present on this native deployment.

Write-time re-read at XDC block 105432932 (Ankr): name()=Aussie Dollar Token, symbol()=AUDX, decimals=18, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xc9d8603bcf23d148a56980e6a7e3e0d375ea3e28)=true. That minter is the same multi-chain DEFAULT_ADMIN+MINTER EOA used on Ethereum/Polygon/XDC in mintAuthority. TAU terms §2 authorize issuance on other blockchains; the issuer website states 12+ supported chains. Same-address ERC-20 deployment with issuer minter role is native issuance, not a third-party bridge representation.

controls.label: AUDX DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE (Ethereum + Polygon + XDC)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xc9d8...) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0..., 0xc9d8...) both returned true on the AUDX ERC1967 proxy (impl: AussieDollarToken). Same confirmed on Polygon at block 88323844. XDC (rpc.xinfin.network, block 0x62dbc1a): hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN, 0xc9d8...) = true, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xc9d8...) = true on the same contract address 0xd687...e00c. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA. Confirmed via RoleGranted events in creation tx (0x8dfc8be2...): all roles (DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, BLACKLISTER, SALVAGER, UPGRADER) granted to this deployer address.

controls.label: AUDX DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE (Conflux eSpace)

Note: this is a different EOA from the Ethereum/Polygon/XDC deployer, consistent with per-chain key management.

review.evidence: AUDX issuer materials describe a single-entity issuer-managed mint and redemption path against fully backed AUD reserves. Exact-block reads confirm four UUPS deployment controls: Ethereum (25534481), Polygon (90246996), Conflux eSpace (152097341), and XDC (104935021) resolve through the canonical EIP-1967 implementation slot with a zero proxy-admin slot and UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0. Ethereum, Polygon, and XDC use EOA 0xc9d8603bcf23d148a56980e6a7e3e0d375ea3e28; Conflux uses EOA 0x1274d87337eb9091e22b9686ae34ad54c989c883. Each EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE on its deployment. Verified Ethereum and Polygon implementation source gates _authorizeUpgrade with onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE); same-implementation upgradeToAndCall eth_call succeeded for Ethereum, Conflux, and XDC. No contract-enforced timelock was observed. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Aura Partners performs monthly independent limited-assurance reconciliation; the latest report covers 2026-05-31 and was signed 2026-06-09. AUSTRAC records match TAU Pty Ltd, but AUSTRAC enrollment is AML registration rather than prudential stablecoin-issuer supervision.
